title: Cow holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='58' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='78' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#555555'/>
  <rect x='44' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#555555'/>
  <rect x='54' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#555555'/>
  <rect x='66' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#555555'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='32' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(-20 28 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(20 72 34)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='23' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#d4a843' transform='rotate(-15 38 23)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='23' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#d4a843' transform='rotate(15 62 23)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='3' fill='#222222'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='3' fill='#222222'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f0b8b8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#c97777'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#c97777'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 53 54 50' stroke='#c97777' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <rect x='25' y='55' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(10 30 57)'/>
  <rect x='65' y='55' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(-10 70 57)'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 54 C50 54 42 48 42 44 C42 40 46 39 48 42 C49 43 50 45 50 45 C50 45 51 43 52 42 C54 39 58 40 58 44 C58 48 50 54 50 54 Z' fill='#ff3b5c'/>
  <!-- heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='43' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#ff7a8a' transform='rotate(-30 46 43)'/>
</svg>
